summary: Implemented the feature without running any tests, linters, or repo code, and without committing. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and changed the default dtype in nifti_writer.py to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters over these. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py. Static checks only: no import cycles, no lines over 120 characters in changed files, and single trailing newlines. Not yet verified: test execution, flake8 run, and ignite 0.3.0 attach behaviour.
